column1: # PEANUTS: Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! base 1.0.0 Android bring-up profile.
# Surveyed from the base dump: SDK 5.4.150, NVN, Game Freak's engine and Wwise.
# Code rewrite and shader split checked on Windows; no device boot verified.
# PEANUTS: the game excludes FullKey on its controller-selection screen (styles
# 0x5a). Handheld exposes the supported Handheld npad; verified on the Thor.
# PEANUTS: the launcher preserves guest 60 Hz; guarded observations in patches.py
# enable normal-speed overworld 60 FPS for caps >=60, retaining native 30 FPS
# menus, battles and capture. Higher 90/120 caps do not unlock those native rates.
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# Rewritten images total 68,701,896 bytes; profile_guess.mem_used rounds them
# to 66 MiB, then adds 4 MiB so SetHeapSize can cover the images.
